extDescription.message: Download whole TikTok short-drama series your own account can watch, paced like one person watching.

appSubtitle.message: Whole TikTok short-drama series, for offline viewing

uiLanguage.description: The language of this catalog, "en" or "es" (not a text to translate): the page shows the engine's texts in it.

statusRunning.description: Engine state badge: a job is running.

duplicateTab.message: DramaFetch is already open in another tab: use that one (one engine at a time).
duplicateTab.description: Banner of a second DramaFetch tab.

cooldownLeft.message: $left$ left — nothing contacts TikTok until then.
cooldownLeft.description: Cooldown countdown: the time left as 45 s or 29 min 07 s (DramaFetch 2.0.0: minutes and seconds).

linksLabel.message: Paste a series link (any episode of it) or a series id: the whole drama downloads at once
linksLabel.description: Label of the box: a paste downloads the whole series.

linksHint.message: Several at once: one per line, in one paste — they download one after the other, each listed right before its own downloads. Typed ids: press Enter (Shift+Enter for a new line). The two boxes above count for the next paste or Enter, then clear. To pick episodes, use See episodes on a drama of your library. Keep this tab open while DramaFetch works.

includeLockedLabel.message: Also ask for locked episodes (TikTok decides; usually they fail)

recheckLabel.message: Look again at series found complete in the last 24 hours

selectAll.description: Accessible label of the select-all box.

colNotAsked.description: Column of the batch table (3.0.1): free episodes DramaFetch did not ask TikTok for because TikTok's list made them look locked (shown as not downloaded (free)).

seriesSkippedComplete.message: $name$ — complete on disk, nothing to do
seriesSkippedComplete.description: Header row of a series skipped as complete.

pauseInForce.description: The progress card's pause line (DramaFetch 2.0.0: the countdown in minutes and seconds): a pause the line has no text of its own for (the text is the engine's; the time left as 45 s or 1 min 07 s).

pausePace.message: Pausing $length$ before the next episode — $left$ left
pausePace.description: The progress card's pause line (DramaFetch 2.0.0: the countdown in minutes and seconds): the pause between two episodes; its length and the time left as 45 s or 1 min 07 s.

pauseRest.description: The progress card's pause line (DramaFetch 2.0.0: the countdown in minutes and seconds): the rest every N downloads.

pauseRestOne.description: The progress card's pause line (DramaFetch 2.0.0: the countdown in minutes and seconds): the rest after one download (a rest every 1).

pauseLongRest.message: Long break of $length$ after $count$ episodes — $left$ left
pauseLongRest.description: The progress card's pause line (DramaFetch 2.0.0: the countdown in minutes and seconds): the long break every 100 episodes.

pauseLongRestOne.message: Long break of $length$ after 1 episode — $left$ left
pauseLongRestOne.description: The progress card's pause line (DramaFetch 2.0.0: the countdown in minutes and seconds): the long break after one episode (test settings only).

pauseSeriesRest.message: Resting $length$ before the next drama — $left$ left
pauseSeriesRest.description: The progress card's pause line (DramaFetch 2.0.0: the countdown in minutes and seconds): the rest between two dramas of a batch.

pauseJobRest.message: Resting $length$ before contacting TikTok again — $left$ left
pauseJobRest.description: The progress card's pause line (DramaFetch 2.0.0: the countdown in minutes and seconds): the rest between jobs, before a job's first request (a download, a listing).

stopButton.description: Button: stop the run at the next pause.

failedHeading.description: Heading of the progress card's block of the episodes a job did not download (their count).

failedAutoRetry.message: $count$ of them will be retried automatically, once.
failedAutoRetry.description: Line under the heading of the episodes a job did not download: how many of them DramaFetch queued for its one automatic retry (DramaFetch 1.8.0).

failedAutoRetryOne.message: 1 of them will be retried automatically, once.

retryButton.message: Retry the episodes that did not download ($count$)
retryButton.description: Button: download the episodes that did not download again, one job per series.

retryAlreadyQueued.description: Status line after a Retry button (the progress card's, a notification's) whose episodes a selection job of the same series already holds — a waiting one (a retry, Download selected, Download all available) or the running one not yet done with that drama: nothing queued twice.

reportButton.description: Button: save the report of the episodes the last job did not download (again, or when the setting is off).

reportSaved.description: The report of the episodes that did not download was saved (its file name).

reportNotSaved.message: The report could not be saved: $reason$
reportNotSaved.description: The report could not be saved (Chrome's reason).

resultTrimmed.message: Only the most recent episode rows are shown; every finished series keeps its line below.
resultTrimmed.description: Under the result table once a long batch has dropped the rows of the episodes it finished long ago (the table keeps about the last 2000 rows).

storageRefused.message: DramaFetch stopped: $reason$. Chrome could not write to its profile folder — usually its disk is full. Free some space, restart Chrome and run again: what is already saved is skipped.
storageRefused.description: Shown when chrome.storage.local refused to store DramaFetch's progress: the engine's reason in the page's language (it ends with Chrome's own words), and what to do.

storageRefusedWait.message: DramaFetch stopped: $reason$. Chrome could not write to its profile folder — usually its disk is full. TikTok also refused a request: free some space, restart Chrome or reload DramaFetch only after $time$ and run again — what is already saved is skipped.
storageRefusedWait.description: Shown instead of storageRefusedCooldown when the cooldown in force is stored: what Chrome accepts after a refused write may not survive its restart, so its end is named all the same. $1 is the engine's reason in the page's language, $2 the cooldown's end (HH:MM).

storageRefusedCooldown.message: DramaFetch stopped: $reason$. Chrome could not write to its profile folder — usually its disk is full. TikTok also refused a request, and the wait until $time$ could not be saved: free some space, restart Chrome or reload DramaFetch only after $time$ and run again — what is already saved is skipped.
storageRefusedCooldown.description: Shown instead of storageRefused when a cooldown is in force too: that wait could not be stored, so restarting Chrome before its end would forget it. $1 is the engine's reason in the page's language, $2 the cooldown's end (HH:MM).

queueRetry.description: A row of the Waiting card (DramaFetch 2.0.0: each drama still to run with its name and whole ID): a Retry (the progress card's, an alert's) of these episodes (E02, E07 — at most ten, then “and N more”).

queueAutoRetry.description: A row of the Waiting card (DramaFetch 2.0.0: each drama still to run with its name and whole ID): the one automatic retry of these episodes (DramaFetch 1.8.0).

queueSelected.description: A row of the Waiting card (DramaFetch 2.0.0: each drama still to run with its name and whole ID): See episodes' Download selected, of these episodes.

queueAvailable.description: A row of the Waiting card (DramaFetch 2.0.0: each drama still to run with its name and whole ID): See episodes' Download all available.

queueSeeEpisodes.description: A row of the Waiting card (DramaFetch 2.0.0: each drama still to run with its name and whole ID): a library card's See episodes (the drama's list, no download).

queueFavorites.description: A row of the Waiting card (DramaFetch 2.0.0: each drama still to run with its name and whole ID): the listing of the user's TikTok favorites into the library (no drama).

queueNameUnknown.message: name shown once its list is read
queueNameUnknown.description: A row of the Waiting card (DramaFetch 2.0.0: each drama still to run with its name and whole ID): after a drama's ID, while DramaFetch does not know its name (it never asks TikTok for one).

queueIdTitle.message: The drama's whole ID: a click selects it, Ctrl+C copies it.
queueIdTitle.description: A row of the Waiting card (DramaFetch 2.0.0: each drama still to run with its name and whole ID): the tooltip of a drama's ID.

loading.message: Listing the series in a background tab… this usually takes 10–40 s.

noLinks.message: Paste at least one series link or id.

queuedOne.message: Series $id$ queued: it downloads whole, with the usual pauses.
queuedOne.description: After a paste, Enter or a hand-over queued one series.

alreadyDownloading.message: Already being downloaded, or waiting to be — not queued twice: $names$.
alreadyDownloading.description: A series (or several, by id) already in a download job: nothing queued for it.

linksKept.message: What the box held before stays there: press Enter to download it.
linksKept.description: After a paste was taken: the box still holds lines it held before the paste (a refused paste's, typed ids), which Enter downloads.

loadAlreadyQueued.message: That series is already being listed; wait for the running job.

jobAutoRetry.description: Queue label of the one automatic retry DramaFetch queued for a drama's episodes that did not download (DramaFetch 1.8.0).

seriesMeta.message: $episodes$ episodes listed, $available$ available (free or unlocked by your account), $ondisk$ already on disk.

selectionLocked.message: ($count$ locked: will be asked for, usually fails)

seriesDrmHint.message: protected by DRM (found by an earlier run): DramaFetch does not decrypt it; tick it and press “$button$” to try again
seriesDrmHint.description: See episodes: the hint of an episode an earlier download found encrypted (shown locked).

badgeFreeTitle.message: Free to watch: downloaded with your session

badgeUnlockedTitle.message: A paid episode your TikTok account has unlocked: downloaded with your session, like a free one

badgeLockedTitle.message: Your account has not unlocked it (or it is protected by DRM): skipped; nothing is ever unlocked

badgeOnDisk.description: Badge of an episode already saved.

badgeOnDiskTitle.message: Already downloaded: “$available$”, or “$selected$” with it ticked, downloads it again in full and replaces the file
badgeOnDiskTitle.description: Tooltip of the on-disk badge in See episodes (DramaFetch 3.0.0: See episodes' buttons download every chosen episode again in full, replacing its file). $1 is the Download all available button's label, $2 the Download selected button's.

favoritesHeading.description: Heading of the panel that lists the user's TikTok favorites (Favorites → Drama).

favoritesFilterPlaceholder.description: Placeholder and label of the favorites panel's filter box (title contains, letter case aside).

favoritesSelectShown.description: Checkbox: tick every drama the filter shows.

favoritesHint.message: Reading the whole list takes 1–2 minutes (about 50 pages, a pause before each). Download on a card downloads that drama; Download selected dramas downloads the ticked ones one after the other — exactly as pasting their links would, skipping the episodes already on disk.
favoritesHint.description: Hint under the favorites panel's buttons.

favoritesListing.message: Listing your favorites from your TikTok tab…
favoritesListing.description: Status while the favorites list is read.

favoritesLoading.description: Favorites count line while the list loads, TikTok's total known.

favoritesLoadingCount.description: Favorites count line while the list loads, no total known.

favoritesListed.description: Favorites count line once the whole list is read.

favoritesListedOf.description: Favorites count line when the listing ended before the list's end.

favoritesCapped.message: DramaFetch reads at most $pages$ pages of the list: the rest is not listed.
favoritesCapped.description: Added to the count line when the listing stopped at its page limit.

favoritesCutShortNote.message: TikTok sent no more of the list: the rest is not listed.
favoritesCutShortNote.description: Added to the favorites count line when TikTok stopped sending the list before its end.

favoritesSkipped.message: $count$ left out: TikTok sent them without a readable series id.
favoritesSkipped.description: Added to the favorites count line when items of the list came without a readable series id (dramaID).

favoritesLoaded.message: $count$ favorite dramas listed: press Download on a drama, or tick several and press Download selected dramas.
favoritesLoaded.description: Status after the favorites list was read.

favoritesCutShort.message: TikTok stopped sending your favorites after $count$ (a page came back empty, or with nothing new): the rest of the list is not shown. For a drama not listed, open it on TikTok and use DramaFetch's toolbar button → Download this series.
favoritesCutShort.description: Status when TikTok stopped sending the favorites list before its end: it refused nothing, so no cooldown.

libraryKept.message: Your library was not updated: $count$ of your favorites were read, not TikTok's whole list, so it stays as it was. Press F5 on your TikTok profile, open Favorites → Drama again, then press Update from TikTok.
libraryKept.description: Status when an update over a library that held dramas did not read TikTok's whole list: the library came back as it was (no stop, no cooldown).

libraryKeptEmpty.message: Your library was not updated: TikTok answered with an empty list of your favorites, so it stays as it was. Press F5 on your TikTok profile, open Favorites → Drama again, then press Update from TikTok.
libraryKeptEmpty.description: Status when an update over a library that held dramas got an empty answer (TikTok may answer a replay it no longer accepts so): the library came back as it was.

favoritesEpisodes.description: A favorite's episodes, its length unknown.

favoritesLengthHours.description: A favorite's length in hours and minutes.

favoritesLengthMinutes.description: A favorite's length under an hour.

favoritesChoose.message: Your favorites are being listed below: press Download on a drama, or tick several and press Download selected dramas.
favoritesChoose.description: Status when a TikTok profile's favorites are handed over: the popup's Open my library there, or Update from TikTok.

favoritesAlreadyQueued.message: Your favorites are already being listed; wait for the running job.
favoritesAlreadyQueued.description: Input error: a second listing of the same tab's favorites.

favoritesNoTemplate.message: DramaFetch has not seen your favorites list in that tab: on your TikTok profile open Favorites → Drama (or press F5 there and open Drama again), then try again.
favoritesNoTemplate.description: No request made: the background worker saw no favorites list request in that TikTok tab.

favoritesTabGone.message: The TikTok tab with your favorites is closed or shows another site: open your profile → Favorites → Drama again, then try again.
favoritesTabGone.description: No request made: the TikTok tab is gone.

favoritesStatusError.message: TikTok did not send your favorites list ($reason$): press F5 on your TikTok profile, open Favorites → Drama again, then try again.
favoritesStatusError.description: TikTok answered the favorites list with its own error (its status message).

favoritesUnreadable.message: Your favorites list could not be read (TikTok answered HTTP $status$ without a list): press F5 on your TikTok profile, open Favorites → Drama again, then try again.
favoritesUnreadable.description: The favorites list's answer held no list and the tab showed no verification wall.

favoritesNoAnswer.message: TikTok did not answer the favorites list's request: check the connection, press F5 on your TikTok profile, open Favorites → Drama again, then try again.
favoritesNoAnswer.description: The favorites list's request got no answer.

navLabel.description: aria-label of the header's section links.

navDownload.description: Header link to the box (Series to download).

navLibrary.description: Header link to the library section.

libraryEmpty.message: Your library is empty: open your TikTok profile → Favorites → Drama, then DramaFetch's toolbar button → Open my library. DramaFetch then shows every drama you keep there.
libraryEmpty.description: Shown instead of the library while none exists.

libraryRefresh.description: Button: the smart refresh of the library from the TikTok tab that shows the list.

libraryRefreshHint.message: To update, open your TikTok profile → Favorites → Drama in a tab of this Chrome.
libraryRefreshHint.description: Under the connection line while no TikTok tab shows the favorites list.

libraryRefreshHintProfile.message: To update, open your TikTok profile ($profile$) → Favorites → Drama in a tab of this Chrome.
libraryRefreshHintProfile.description: Under the connection line while no tab of the library's own TikTok profile shows the favorites list; $profile$ is that profile's @handle.

libraryHint.message: No password and no separate API: DramaFetch reads the same list your profile shows, from your own TikTok tab, with pauses. Nothing downloads until you ask.
libraryHint.description: How the library connects to TikTok.

libraryReadFrom.description: Connection line, first part (no profile known).

libraryReadFromProfile.description: Connection line, first part: $profile$ is the @handle.

libraryAgeNow.description: Connection line: when the list or its count was read.

libraryAgeMinutes.description: Connection line: minutes since the last read.

libraryAgeHours.description: Connection line: hours since the last read.

libraryAgeDays.description: Connection line: days since the last read.

libraryTotal.description: Connection line: TikTok's own count of the Bookmark (the list's total).

libraryTotalUnknown.message: TikTok did not say how many dramas it counts
libraryTotalUnknown.description: Connection line when the list carried no total.

libraryStale.message: This list has $count$: press Update from TikTok to bring it up to date
libraryStale.description: Under the connection line when the library holds another number of dramas than TikTok counts.

libraryUnchanged.description: The smart refresh's first page found the library as it was (one request).

librarySelectionNote.message: downloaded one after the other, with the usual pauses

libraryDownload.description: Selection bar button: one batch job with the ticked dramas.

libraryQueuedJob.message: $count$ series queued: they download one after the other, with the usual pauses.

libraryQueuedDrama.message: $name$ queued: it downloads whole, with the usual pauses.

libraryDownloadOne.description: Button on a library card: download that drama.

libraryTwin.description: Badge of a drama whose title another different drama of the library bears.

libraryQueued.description: Card status: a waiting job will download it.

libraryBrowse.description: Card button: lists that drama's episodes with their covers (a listing job), to download all available or pick from.

libraryOpen.description: Card button: the drama in a normal tab.

librarySaveRefused.message: The library could not be kept on this computer ($reason$): it is read from TikTok again next time.
librarySaveRefused.description: Said once when chrome.storage.local refused the library (a cache: nothing stops).

popupLibrary.description: Popup button; $count$ is TikTok's count the library kept.

popupLibraryOpen.description: Popup button before the library has a count.

jobFavorites.description: Queue label: the favorites list job.

settingReport.message: Save a report of the episodes that did not download

settingReportHint.message: A JSON file in Downloads/DramaFetch/reports: for each episode that did not download, its status, message, probable cause, the requests made (hosts, HTTP statuses, sizes) and the list entry TikTok served to your session — never your cookies.

settingAlerts.message: Alert me when a drama finishes
settingAlerts.description: Setting label (a checkbox): a notification from Chrome as each drama a download job finishes.

settingAlertsHint.message: A notification from Chrome as each drama a download finishes: downloaded, or the episodes to retry, with a Retry button. None shows? Allow Chrome's notifications in Windows (Settings → System → Notifications) and check that Focus assist (Do not disturb) is off.

settingAutoRetry.message: Retry on its own what did not download
settingAutoRetry.description: Setting label (a checkbox): one automatic retry of a drama's episodes that did not download for a reason a retry can change (DramaFetch 1.8.0).

settingAutoRetryHint.message: When a drama's download ends with episodes that did not download for a reason a retry can change — a cut transfer, a file that failed its check, a network error —, DramaFetch queues one retry of them, the same as pressing Retry: the rest between downloads, a fresh list, the usual pauses. Never after TikTok refused a request, during the 30-minute cooldown or after a stop, and never for locked, DRM-protected or short-served episodes.
settingAutoRetryHint.description: Hint under the automatic retry setting.

settingsHint.message: File names may use {series}, {number}, {n}, {title} and {id}. Pauses may only be made longer than the defaults (4–9 s between episodes, 60–120 s every 10): faster is never safe against TikTok.

alertCompleteTitle.description: Notification title: every episode of the drama the session may play is on disk (its report says complete).

alertNothingPlayableTitle.description: Notification title instead of alertCompleteTitle when the drama's report says complete but the session may play none of its episodes (every one locked): nothing was saved, so no ✓ and no “downloaded”; alertNoneOnDisk is its message.

alertAllOnDisk.description: Notification message of a complete drama. $locked$ is empty, or “ — ” and its locked episodes in the words of its report line (“ — 2 locked (61, 62)”).

alertOneOnDisk.description: The same, when the session may play one episode of the drama — others may be locked, so never “its only episode” ($locked$ as in alertAllOnDisk).

alertNoneOnDisk.message: Your account may play none of its episodes$locked$.
alertNoneOnDisk.description: The same, for a complete drama whose every episode is locked ($locked$ as in alertAllOnDisk: never empty here).

alertRetryTitle.description: Notification title: episodes of the drama did not download (failed, or left by a stop); its Retry button queues them again.

alertRetryMessage.description: Notification message: the episodes (E03, E07, E12) — at most ten, then alertMore.

alertMissingMessage.description: Notification message (3.0.1): the episodes TikTok's list lacked (E61, E62) — at most ten, then alertMore; after alertRetryMessage when some did not download either.

alertGuessedMessage.message: $episodes$ were not asked for: TikTok's list made them look locked.
alertGuessedMessage.description: Notification message (3.0.1): the free episodes DramaFetch did not ask TikTok for because its own rules guessed they were locked (a short header, no play address) — E03, E17, at most ten, then alertMore; Retry asks for them anyway.

alertGuessedMessageOne.message: $episode$ was not asked for: TikTok's list made it look locked.
alertGuessedMessageOne.description: The same, for one episode (E03), when the list gave no hint.

alertGuessedMessageOneHint.message: $episode$ was not asked for: TikTok's list made it look locked ($hint$).
alertGuessedMessageOneHint.description: The same, for one episode (E03), with what the list said of it (plays 2 s of 3 s; no play address).

alertMore.description: The first ten episodes named, and how many more did not download.

alertRetryButton.description: The notification's button: what the tab's Retry button does for that drama.

alertIncompleteTitle.description: Notification title: the drama has nothing to retry but is not complete (a gap in TikTok's list, an episode TikTok did not list, a list it refused); its report line is the message.

alertListIncompleteTitle.description: Notification title (3.0.1): the drama has nothing to retry but TikTok's list itself is short — a number missing that the job did not take, or the list ended early while TikTok's count is unknown; its report line is the message.

alertStoppedTitle.description: Notification title at the end of a download job that stopped with dramas never started; the reason as the tab shows it.

alertNotStarted.message: $count$ dramas were not started — download them again later

alertNotStartedOne.message: 1 drama was not started — download it again later

alertAutoRetryTitle.description: Notification title instead of alertRetryTitle when DramaFetch queued its one automatic retry of the drama's episodes that did not download (DramaFetch 1.8.0): no button, the retry is queued already.

alertAutoRetryMessage.message: $episodes$ did not download — DramaFetch tries them once more on its own.
alertAutoRetryMessage.description: Notification message under alertAutoRetryTitle: the episodes the automatic retry takes (E03, E07) — at most ten, then alertMore.

alertAutoRetryMessageOne.message: $episode$ did not download — DramaFetch tries it once more on its own.

alertAutoRetryAgain.message: DramaFetch tries once more on its own.
alertAutoRetryAgain.description: Notification message ending (3.0.1), after alertMissingMessage under alertAutoRetryTitle: the automatic retry lists the drama again and asks for those episodes once more.

alertAfterAutoRetry.description: Notification context line of the drama's alert at the end of its automatic retry (downloaded, episodes to retry, or not complete) when the retry did not stop.

alertAutoRetryNotRun.description: Notification context line of the episodes-to-retry alert of a drama whose automatic retry never ran: a stop took it out of the queue, it was refused at its start, or Stop or an error ended it before any request (the reason as the tab shows it).

testHeading.description: Heading of the test card (test copy only).

testLabel.message: Test settings (JSON), honoured only by this test copy of the extension
testLabel.description: Label of the test settings box.

popupDownload.description: Popup button: the DramaFetch tab downloads this tab's whole series (the job a paste of it queues).

popupSeries.description: Popup: the series of this tab.

popupHint.message: Open a TikTok short drama to download its whole series, or paste links in the DramaFetch tab.

popupFavoritesHint.message: To open your library, show Favorites → Drama on your TikTok profile first, then click DramaFetch again.
popupFavoritesHint.description: Popup hint on a TikTok profile page before its Favorites → Drama list was shown.

legalNotice.message: DramaFetch is for personal, offline viewing of episodes that your own TikTok account can already watch. It does not unlock paid episodes and does not bypass DRM or access controls; locked episodes are listed and skipped. Downloading may breach TikTok's Terms of Service, and the videos belong to their creators and studios — you are responsible for how you use this tool.
legalNotice.description: The README's legal notice, verbatim, in English (both locales).

legalNoticeSpanish.message: DramaFetch es para ver sin conexión, de forma personal, episodios que tu propia cuenta de TikTok ya puede ver. No desbloquea episodios de pago y no elude el DRM ni los controles de acceso; los episodios bloqueados se listan y se omiten. Descargar puede infringir las Condiciones del servicio de TikTok, y los videos pertenecen a sus creadores y estudios — eres responsable de cómo usas esta herramienta.
legalNoticeSpanish.description: The legal notice in Spanish (both locales).
